title: Remarks on DAG exchangeability and generalized wreath products
summary: Motivated by the structure of various standard statistical arrays, Bailey, Praeger, Rowley and Speed (1983) described the automorphism groups of poset block structures as generalized wreath products. We observe that these are exactly the groups used to define DAG exchangeability in Jung, Lee, Staton and Yang (2021), and we restate the representation theorem of the latter work in this language. As a concrete example, we write out the resulting representation for block matrices whose block rows and block columns are separately exchangeable, and whose rows and columns may also be permuted…
